Spend per active user softened slightly after March, but transaction frequency also changed only modestly and active users continued to grow; the short movement does not establish a broader usage decline.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"Romania card spend per active user","baseline_value":319.548121,"anomaly_value":312.602723,"unit":"EUR/user","sql":"SELECT a.month, SUM(a.card_spend_eur)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END),0) AS spend_per_active FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' AND a.month IN (DATE '2026-03-01', DATE '2026-05-01') GROUP BY a.month ORDER BY a.month"},{"name":"Romania card transactions per active user","baseline_value":11.947109,"anomaly_value":11.793446,"unit":"count/user","sql":"SELECT a.month, SUM(a.n_card_txns)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END),0) AS txns_per_active FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' AND a.month IN (DATE '2026-03-01', DATE '2026-05-01') GROUP BY a.month ORDER BY a.month"},{"name":"Romania monthly active card users","baseline_value":5483,"anomaly_value":6042,"unit":"count","sql":"SELECT a.month, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END) AS active_users FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' AND a.month IN (DATE '2026-03-01', DATE '2026-05-01') GROUP BY a.month ORDER BY a.month"}],"recommended_action":"NO_ACTION_NOISE","reasoning_summary":"Spend per active user eased from EUR 319.55 in March to EUR 312.60 in May. Transactions per active user also edged down, from 11.95 to 11.79, while monthly active card users rose from 5,483 to 6,042. This two-month shift, alongside expanding active usage, is not sufficient evidence of a broader Romanian card-usage decline."}
